New bounded claims: interrupt Arcane Storm every cast; purge Remedy or let a mage Spellsteal it; interrupt Release Aberrations when enough adds are up, ideally dealing with nine at a time; interrupt only the first Release of a cycle; Aberrations kited by a tank away from Maloriak; face the boss to the raid only in Red, away otherwise; Blue spread 5 yards and ranged break Flash Freeze; Green: Debilitating Slime also removes Growth Catalyst, AoE all nine adds in 15 s; Prime Subjects picked up by off-tanks and ignored; Maloriak tank keeps moving out of Magma Jets; avoid Absolute Zero spheres; rotate raid cooldowns for Acid Nova; 6-minute enrage wording.

phase_reset_credit.behavior: Creature::Respawn (Creature.cpp 2052-2053) only calls AI()->Reset(); the AI object is not rebuilt after _DespawnAtEvade. Before 2026-09-25 Reset() left _currentVial, _usedVialsCount and _releasedAberrationsCount from the failed attempt (first vial could be Green, the release reserve could start exhausted) and the constructor started at VIAL_RED, so the first normal vial was always Blue. Reset() now starts a fresh cycle (VIAL_GREEN sentinel, counters 0).

route_and_shard_20260925.round1_plateau_root_cause: The shard started on the Mongrel 250119 spawn, which is also the regroup and trash anchor. The patrol (Slayer 250117 with Mongrels 250118/250119) was engaged at the regroup; the future-encounter guard forbade offense against the next node entry 42803 while the node could not complete, so the cohort killed the unlisted Slayer and then stayed in combat with the guarded Mongrels until the 180 s plateau.
route_and_shard_20260925.second_blocker: Adaptive owners suppress the generic route objective; only adaptive Magmaw records native boss engagement (BotWorldPopulationMgrUpdateBotKernelFallback.cpp observeAdaptiveMagmawRoute -> RememberValidationRouteBossEngagement). Without it NotifyCreatureDeath rejects the Maloriak kill (ValidationRouteEngagedBossGuid empty), so a native clear would never complete the route. Patch requested.
